data.one_liner: Cross-platform installation and auto-update framework for desktop apps
data.what_it_does: Enables desktop apps to check for, download, and apply updates using Velopack and a Rust bridge. Supports release channels and downgrades.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for Windows, macOS, or Linux
You need automated updates and installations outside of official app stores
avoid_when: You are building a mobile or web app
You rely entirely on Microsoft or Mac App Stores for distribution
weaknesses: Requires Rust toolchain and vpk packaging tooling
API functions throw exceptions if called outside a vpk packed release
data.setup_notes: Requires Rust installed on the machine, configuring flutter_rust_bridge, and packaging the app using the .NET vpk tool.
